quotations.old_english: Se flǽscbana hæfde þ-bar; getogene sweord on his handa and mid stranglice hígunge áhóf þone earm upp in heánesse and mynte sleán þone Godes wer

source_text: hígung, e; f. Striving, endeavour, effort :-- Se flǽscbana hæfde þ-bar; getogene sweord on his handa and mid stranglice hígunge (nisu forti) áhóf þone earm upp in heánesse and mynte sleán þone Godes wer, Gr. D. 254, 34. v. tó-hígung; hígþ.
